summary: Build practical data science skills for business decisions with CRISP-DM, SQL, dashboards, and predictive analytics. Enrol today.
lede: Corporate data science training helps business analysts, product and operations managers, and functional leaders use data to answer business questions. Participants practise framing problems with CRISP-DM, preparing and checking data with SQL and pandas, and communicating findings through statistical interpretation, model evaluation, and Power BI dashboards. They also create analytical briefs and action plans to support decisions.
audienceIntro: This business data science course suits professionals who make decisions with operational, customer, financial, workforce, or product data and need stronger analytical judgment without becoming specialist data engineers.
prerequisites: Working experience with business data, spreadsheets, reports, or operational KPIs is expected. Basic familiarity with databases or analytical terminology is useful. No advanced mathematics or software engineering background is required. Coding is not required for course completion, although guided SQL and Python pandas activities may be used for applied practice.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
